title: a merge into cairn runs the commit door
intention: A git merge into the cairn repo runs the same commit door as a commit: the artifact check that blocks, then the reseal.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: every land on main skipped the artifact check. A land is a non-conflicting git merge, which runs pre-merge-commit and not pre-commit, and neither repo's .git/hooks holds a pre-merge-commit. 7 of the last 40 cairn main commits and 8 of the last 40 commons main commits are merges.
traces_to: Law 4 and Law 8: the artifact door is physics only if every path into main passes it, and a land is a path into main.
how: Add cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-merge-commit, carrying the cairn-reseal-door marker. It unsets GIT_INDEX_FILE and execs the installed pre-commit, found with git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-commit. This is git's own pre-merge-commit.sample pattern, so there is one door, not a copy. The unset is needed because MERGE_HEAD is written only after this hook runs, so check_shared_index (artifact.py:994) would refuse every land as a shared-index commit. git merge refuses to start over a staged index (measured rc 2), so the index holds only the merge, and with no GIT_INDEX_FILE the check reads that same index as a hand check. install_hook installs both files: it keeps returning the pre-commit path as path, adds paths, and reports installed when either is copied. verify_hook is green only when both are installed, executable and identical to source. The proof builds a scratch repo holding stub doors at cairn/tools/artifact/__main__.py (refuses a staged path containing 'hand-edit', and writes the GIT_INDEX_FILE it saw to a file outside the repo) and cairn/devices/tester/cli.py, plus empty cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py and cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py so the hook's guards pass. It installs the hooks with install_hook and merges with --no-ff.

clauses.claim: install_hook installs pre-merge-commit beside pre-commit, LF, executable and equal to its tracked source; verify_hook is green with both and red with pre-merge-commit removed

a non-conflicting merge of a branch staging a path the door refuses is refused: git merge exits non-zero, HEAD does not move, and the door's refusal is on stderr; red on origin/main, where the merge commits
a non-conflicting merge of a clean branch commits, and the door it ran saw no GIT_INDEX_FILE, so the shared-index guard reads it as a hand check

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-merge-commit unsets GIT_INDEX_FILE and execs the installed pre-commit.
D2: install_hook and verify_hook cover both hook files; path stays the pre-commit path.
D3: one proof, a scratch repo with stub doors, one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-commit (the commons' hook, a sibling ticket)

measured.saw: 7 of the last 40 cairn origin/main commits and 8 of the last 40 commons origin/main commits have two parents; .git/hooks in both repos holds only pre-commit and commit-msg
measured.how: git log --format=%p -40 origin/main | awk 'NF>1' | wc -l, and ls .git/hooks, in each repo

measured.saw: inside pre-merge-commit, GIT_INDEX_FILE=.git/index (or the worktree's index) and MERGE_HEAD does not exist; a refused merge leaves MERGE_HEAD and the merge staged; git merge over a staged unrelated file exits 2 without merging
measured.how: a scratch repo and a scratch worktree with a recording pre-merge-commit hook
